title: Extraordinarily
summary: EXTRAOR'DINARILY, adverb extror'dinarily. [See Extraordinary.] In a manner out of the ordinary or usual method; beyond the common course, limits or order; in an uncommon degree; remarkably; particular

inlines.v: EXTRAOR'DINARILY, adverb extror'dinarily. [See Extraordinary.] In a manner out of the ordinary or usual method; beyond the common course, limits or order; in an uncommon degree; remarkably; particularly; eminently. The temple of Solomon was extraordinarily magnificent.
